page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL40S is a GPU-accelerated virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 20 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor clocked at 2.0 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.8 GB per core. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, though it includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance in single-core and multi-core operations. The AMD EPYC 9575F processor achieves top 10% scores in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, alongside strong multi-core stress-ng performance. Memory bandwidth is robust, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 3960.24 GB/sec and uncached large block reads at 309.72 GB/sec. For AI workloads, the NVIDIA L40S GPU delivers top-tier LLM inference speeds for small models, processing 4434.62 tokens per second for prompts. Performance for medium 7B models remains strong, while large 70B models operate in the average tier, generating 3.97 tokens per second.

This server offers high resource density, combining a high-capacity GPU with a substantial 256 GB memory footprint, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-intensive parallel computing without requiring a multi-GPU setup. However, the lack of local storage requires external volume attachments, which may introduce I/O latency tradeoffs. The CPU allocation is shared, which could impact performance consistency under sustained co-tenant load. This configuration is highly suited for deep learning, LLM inference on small-to-medium models, data science pipelines, and rendering workloads.
description: The UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL40S is a high-performance, GPU-accelerated virtual server designed for resource-intensive workloads. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 20 physical cores and 256.0 GB of RAM, it integrates a single NVIDIA L40S GPU with 48 GB of VRAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this server delivers top-tier single-core and multi-core CPU performance, alongside strong memory bandwidth. While it lacks local storage, its hardware profile is highly optimized for parallel processing. Benchmark data highlights exceptional efficiency in small-to-medium LLM inference, image processing, and software compilation. This instance is best suited for machine learning inference, data science, and GPU-accelerated rendering.
